detached_parameters_excluded.expected: autograd.grad rejects inputs without a gradient graph

non_psd_density_excluded.expected: entropy fixture rejects a trace-one matrix with a negative eigenvalue

surviving_alternatives: Higher-dimensional density matrices, complex Hermitian inputs, PyG message passing, and bridge claims remain separate future micro surfaces.
demotion_condition: Demote PyTorch for this surface if eigvalsh/autograd.grad fail to produce finite entropy gradients on normalized PSD matrices, if detached inputs are silently accepted, or if non-PSD matrices are admitted by the fixture.
out_of_scope: no proof of the whole PyTorch linear algebra surface
criteria_checked: PyTorch eigvalsh entropy on trace-one PSD density matrix
PyTorch autograd entropy gradient against finite difference
maximally mixed and near-pure boundary behavior
